findingClass: ipos.segment is non-NULL with NO field_sources row for the segment field — a value with no record of who said it (the binary-test write bug, lane C item 2 slice 3b: 'not detected as SME' was asserted as MAINBOARD with no source)
failThreshold: any ipos row with segment IS NOT NULL and no field_sources row (table_name='ipos', field_name='segment') for that ipo_id
unverifiableWhen: never — always runs against the ipos and field_sources tables
note: Closes the detection gap left after scripts/repair-segment-provenance.ts repaired the existing 41-62 rows: that tool clears segment ONLY for non-IPO offering types (segment is meaningless there) and REPORTS-only for unsourced IPO rows (clearing a probably-correct label would destroy real information the missing provenance row already expresses). This check is what stops the gap from reopening on the next write path that skips field_sources — measured missing on 2026-09-10: no existing check asserts provenance PRESENCE (checkSegmentPopulatedForIpo measures SHARE; g_provenance_lineage in audit-ipo-coverage.mjs measures a declining-ceiling ratchet on lineage generally, not this specific field/table pair).
